name: delivery-route-tracker
description: Live delivery tracking: an Expo map client and a NestJS API over OpenStreetMap, OSRM and Nominatim.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @tracker/geo && npm run build -w @tracker/api
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start:dev -w @tracker/api" "npm run web -w @tracker/mobile"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @tracker/geo && npm run test -w @tracker/api && npm run test -w @tracker/mobile
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @tracker/geo && npm run typecheck -w @tracker/api && npm run typecheck -w @tracker/mobile
